typing.passage: Our returns policy is simple. If you change your mind about something you bought from us, you can return it within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. The item must be unused and in its original box, with all the parts and papers that came with it. To start a return, log in to your account, go to My Orders, and choose the item you want to send back. We will email you a free return label within 24 hours. Print the label, stick it on the box, and drop the parcel at any post office or parcel shop. Please keep your receipt until the refund arrives. Once we receive the item, we check it within 2 working days. If everything is in order, we send the refund to the card you paid with. Most banks take 3 to 5 working days to show the money in your account, and you will get an email from us on the day we send it. Some items cannot be returned once they are opened, such as earphones, make-up and food, for health reasons. Items that are faulty are different. If something stops working, you are covered by our 12-month warranty, even after the 30 days have passed. In that case, contact us with your order number and a short photo or video of the problem, and we will repair or replace it free of charge. If you have any questions about a return, our team is happy to help by chat, email or phone, 7 days a week.

typing.passage: We understand that money can be tight sometimes, and we want to help if you are finding it hard to pay your bill. Please contact us as early as you can, before a payment is missed, as there are more options at that stage. When you call, one of our team will ask a few questions about your income and your regular costs. This helps us find a plan that you can really afford. There is no charge for this, and it will not affect your credit score. Most of the 1,500 customers we help each month choose one of 3 options. The first is a payment plan, where you pay what you owe in smaller amounts over 3, 6 or 12 months. The second is a short payment break of up to 2 months, if you are waiting for new work or for money that you are sure is coming. The third is moving to a cheaper plan, which can lower your monthly bill straight away. While you are on a plan with us, we will not add any late fees, and your service will not be stopped as long as you keep to the agreed payments. If your situation changes, just let us know and we will look at the plan again. You can also get free and private advice about money and debt from advice services in your area. Please do not ignore letters from us, even if you cannot pay right now. Talking to us early is always the best first step.

typing.passage: Why do we ask security questions? We know it can feel slow to answer questions before we can help you, but these checks are there to keep your account safe. Each month, our checks stop more than 2,000 calls from people who pretend to be someone else. When you contact us, we will ask for your full name and two pieces of information from the account, such as your date of birth and the last 4 digits of the card you use to pay. We will never ask for your full 16-digit card number, your password or a code that we have sent to your phone. If someone asks for these, it is not us. We can only discuss an account with the account holder or with someone they have added as an authorised person. This is true even for close family, such as a husband, wife or parent. If you would like someone to be able to help with your account, you can add them in the app under Settings, or call us together and we will set it up in about 5 minutes. If you are not able to manage your account because of illness or age, a family member can apply to act for you with the right legal papers. Our team can explain how this works and send the forms. If you think someone has got into your account, call us straight away on our free number, which is open 24 hours a day. We will lock the account and help you check every recent change.
